description:
# Phantom Movies v1.7.3

## Subtitle fixes

- Fixed subtitle addon lookup for built-in Phantom titles that need their movie or episode identifier resolved.
- Fixed addon subtitles that appeared in the menu but did not display during playback.
- Improved SRT, WebVTT, and SSA/ASS support, including download links without file extensions, compressed responses, redirects, and UTF-16 subtitle files.
- Fixed manual addon subtitle selection when the preferred subtitle setting is Off.
- Kept playback position and pause state when switching or removing addon subtitles.
- Made addon results appear as providers respond, so a slow provider does not hold up the other results.
- Prevented failed or unsupported subtitle downloads from replacing the playing video.

These fixes apply to playback in the phone player for Phantom and addon streams.

releases.description:
# Phantom Movies v1.7.2

## New: Addon casting
- Added casting support for addon sources, including video and audio playback on Cast devices.
- Added stereo audio conversion for incompatible and surround-audio addon sources.
- Added movie and series titles to addon casting.
- Added season numbers, episode numbers, and episode titles when casting TV episodes.
- Added addon buffering coordination so phone playback and the Cast receiver do not compete for addon pieces.

## Phantom casting fix
- Fixed the regression that prevented previously working built-in Phantom streams from casting properly.

## Playback improvements
- Connected the player's pause, resume, seek, and Skip Intro controls to Cast playback.
- Corrected Cast progress tracking to follow receiver playback instead of the converter's buffering position.
- Adjusted startup timeout handling to avoid interrupting pending Cast loads.
- Improved cleanup and return-to-phone playback when casting fails or stops.

Existing addons, settings, and app features are retained.

releases.description:
# Phantom Movies v1.7.1

## Casting fixes
- Added a fallback stream relay for sources that require the phone's playback headers. HLS playlists, segments and encryption keys retain those headers when casting.
- Stopped the phone's torrent player from buffering against the receiver's torrent requests during casting.
- Coordinated concurrent torrent reads to reduce competing seek requests.
- Improved Cast loading failure handling and return to phone playback.
- Casting confirmation now waits for playback progress instead of only a successful load request.

## Compatibility
- Cast format and codec support depends on the receiving device.
